_readme: 11 categories from your Dataset.xlsx (sheet 'Классификатор'). id = value of the 'type' column in labels.csv.
label_ru must match the category text in column E of the labels sheet (text before the brackets is compared).
choice_en / grounding_en: queries for the model, in English. They describe the VISIBLE action. Drafts: tune them on your videos.

source: fill ONLY with references you have checked yourself. ForteBank is a second-tier bank, so the primary act is the rules for second-tier banks (НБРК resolution of 29.11.2019 No. 231); premises and access: НБРК resolution of 24.02.2020 No. 14. Rules No. 120 govern cash operations inside the National Bank itself: use them at most as a supporting analogy.
draft_ref_nb120: your current references to Rules No. 120, kept for reference. The service does not show them.
FAQ 32: every violation in the dataset has an open norm, so the three categories marked 'no direct norm' still need a source.
